boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented Mount Carmel College of Nursing ceremonies and recurring community practices centered on nursing education, service, and alumni connection.

cards.title: Sophomore Pinning Ceremony
cards.subtitle: A transition from classroom study to clinical care
cards.notes: Look for the ceremony’s lamp-pin moment: MCCN describes Sophomore Pinning as the milestone marking entry into direct patient care.
cards.short_summary: A formal marker of the move into clinical nursing education.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN calls Sophomore Pinning an annual tradition and a rite of passage marking academic achievement and the transition toward patient care.
cards.source_title: SDAP Students to Celebrate with Sophomore Pinning Ceremony
cards.access_notes: Ceremony participation and guest access vary by cohort and invitation.

cards.title: The Lamp Pin
cards.subtitle: The sophomore pin used before the graduate pin
cards.notes: Notice the engraved lamp on the sophomore pin; it is the specific object MCCN uses to mark students’ clinical-care transition.
cards.short_summary: A nursing-school milestone expressed through a lamp-shaped symbol.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN states that Sophomore Pinning presents an engraved lamp pin, recalling Florence Nightingale’s lamp, and that a graduate pin later replaces it.
cards.source_title: First Sophomore Pinning for Collaborative Nursing Program
cards.access_notes: The pin is presented through the Sophomore Pinning Ceremony; it is not a public drop-in display.

cards.entity_name: Baccalaureate Pinning and Presentation of Student Awards
cards.title: Baccalaureate Pinning
cards.subtitle: Graduation-week recognition for baccalaureate students
cards.notes: If attending graduation events, distinguish this baccalaureate pinning and awards program from sophomore pinning earlier in the program.
cards.short_summary: A graduation-week ceremony pairing pinning with student recognition.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN’s 2019 alumni news lists Baccalaureate Pinning and Presentation of Student Awards as part of its May graduation celebrations.
cards.access_notes: Event timing and access are set by the College for each graduating class.

cards.entity_name: Graduate Program Blessing and Recognition Ceremony
cards.title: Graduate Program Blessing and Recognition
cards.subtitle: A faith-linked recognition ceremony for graduate students
cards.notes: Look for this separate graduate-program observance in commencement programming; MCCN documented it alongside its 2019 graduation events.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated blessing and recognition event for graduate nursing students.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN reported a Graduate Program Blessing and Recognition Ceremony during its Class of 2019 graduation celebrations.
cards.access_notes: Check College graduation communications for current scheduling and guest details.

cards.title: Commencement
cards.subtitle: The College’s annual degree-conferral celebration
cards.notes: Treat commencement as the culminating event after recognition and pinning programs; MCCN’s recent coverage documents a distinct annual ceremony.
cards.short_summary: The formal close of a Mount Carmel nursing degree.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN states that it held its annual Commencement in May 2025 for graduates across BSN, RN-to-BSN, and MS programs.
cards.source_title: Mount Carmel College of Nursing Celebrates Commencement May 8-9
cards.access_notes: Attendance is arranged through commencement communications for graduates and invited guests.

cards.title: New Student Convocation
cards.subtitle: The academic-year opening ceremony
cards.notes: Watch for Convocation at the close of New Student Welcome; it formally gathers new students with faculty and College leadership.
cards.short_summary: An opening-of-year welcome ceremony for a new MCCN class.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN described Convocation as its ceremony celebrating the start of the academic year and capping New Student Welcome.
cards.source_title: Mount Carmel College of Nursing Convocation Ceremony to Celebrate the Start of the 2018-19 Academic Year
cards.access_notes: This is tied to new-student orientation; current participation details come from MCCN.

cards.title: The Bagpiper-Led Procession
cards.subtitle: A musical welcome for the incoming class
cards.notes: See the incoming class process behind a bagpiper and faculty in academic regalia as part of MCCN’s Convocation tradition.
cards.short_summary: A bagpipe-led walk that turns orientation into a ceremonial arrival.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN states that, in keeping with Convocation tradition, a bagpiper leads the newest class in the opening procession.
cards.source_title: Mount Carmel College of Nursing Convocation Ceremony to Celebrate the Start of the 2018-19 Academic Year
cards.access_notes: The procession is part of Convocation; route and participation may change with each orientation.

cards.title: Interfaith Thanksgiving Prayer Service
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry’s seasonal gathering
cards.notes: Follow Campus Ministry updates for the College’s Thanksgiving observance, which has included interfaith prayers and material support for outreach.
cards.short_summary: A Thanksgiving gathering linking faith traditions with community care.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN documented an Interfaith Thanksgiving Prayer Service hosted by Campus Ministry with Christian, Islamic, and Jewish representatives.
cards.source_title: Mount Carmel College of Nursing Harvests a Community of Faith at Thanksgiving Prayer Service
cards.access_notes: Current observance details are determined by Campus Ministry; participation is under-21-safe.

cards.entity_name: MCCN Scholarship and Donor Recognition Dinner
cards.title: Scholarship and Donor Recognition Dinner
cards.subtitle: An annual student-and-benefactor gathering
cards.notes: Use the event to connect scholarship recipients with the people supporting them; MCCN documents this as an annual recognition dinner.
cards.short_summary: A recurring gathering that makes scholarship support personal.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN reported hosting its annual Scholarship and Donor Recognition Dinner on September 19, 2024.
cards.access_notes: Attendance is generally coordinated through scholarship, donor, alumni, and College invitations.

cards.entity_name: Mount Carmel Alumni Association Annual Meeting and Homecoming
cards.title: Alumni Homecoming
cards.subtitle: The recurring MCAA reunion and annual meeting
cards.notes: Check Alumni Relations for the next gathering; the event combines class reconnection with the Mount Carmel Alumni Association’s annual meeting.
cards.short_summary: An alumni tradition that brings graduating classes back into the College community.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN’s 2024 AlumNews invited alumni to the Mount Carmel Alumni Association Annual Meeting and Homecoming Celebration.
cards.access_notes: Registration and venue information are announced by MCCN Alumni Relations for each event.

warnings: Several documented traditions are supported by archival College sources; confirm future dates and participation requirements directly with MCCN.
